scope: Training catalogue for tau only; development smoke only; frozen screen for analysis. Never M0 official val/test.
gates: B0 completed-candidate rates agree with PR107 full precision within 1e-9
Three smallest screen n_enum parents (tie parent_id) filtered channel sets equal enumerate_events(size=2)
subset: Filter archived b3f3 with upper-triangle sum(max(-delta_b,0)) <=2 and sum(max(delta_b,0)) <=2. Do not re-enumerate except the three-parent gate.

pipeline.embedding: one ETKDGv3 conformer; retry once with useRandomCoords=True
pipeline.forcefield: MMFF94 maxIters=1000; UFF if no MMFF parameters; no_forcefield if neither, retain embedded geometry
pipeline.energy: review_oracle_benchmark.energy AIMNet2; aimnet2_wb97m_d3_0.pt; neutral charge 0; kcal/mol
pipeline.reaction_energy: product minus reactant using identical pipelines

tau.channels: all distinct catalogue channel_id per parent; representative record by reference_id ascending
tau.freeze: Write tau, success rate and distribution to configs/explore/enum_thermo_tau.json; commit and push before screen acquisition

scorers.S_thermo: successful delta_E ascending; failures after all successes by S_N
scorers.S_N_thermo: successful delta_E<=tau first by S_N; all remaining by S_N

metric_reuse: ranked_curve and paired_auc; original generator input and enum_baseline.json censoring, no generation rerun
intervals: Average seed values within parent; paired parent differences; cluster_summary grouped by split_group, two-sided 95%
additional: primary conditioned on best in b2f2
parents with best outside b2f2 but generated best hit

resources.smoke: first two development parent_ids; workflow only, no scientific metrics
resources.timing: first five training parent_ids; mean per-event time times screen b2f2 total
resources.fallback: If full estimate >60 core-hours choose first 171 screen parent_ids by sha256(parent_id); stop if fallback also exceeds budget

claim_limits: Exploratory proxy best-event recall, not certified TS or chemical discovery. Report first sentence: 本报告全部结果为探索性
